description: FDA medical device risk brief — One call: everything public FDA records say about a medical device type, by 3-letter product_code or device= name (e.g. infusion pump). Risk class, 21 CFR regulation with eCFR link, implant and life-sustaining flags, likely premarket pathway, 510(k) clearance and PMA counts with the latest decisions, MAUDE adverse event reports all-time and last 12 months (deaths, injuries, malfunctions) with the top reported problems, recalls all-time and last 24 months, and an attention level LOW / MODERATE / ELEVATED / HIGH ATTENTION with the reasons. A screening signal, not a safety rating. Source: openFDA (CC0). Price: $0.02 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: fda_device_brief
